ownership: Reviewed classic command-line invocations under this OS account's disclosed choice. Command handlers, imported calls without ownership, help, private output and unresolved command paths are not fallback feeds.

exclusions.state_inspection: Inspecting configuration or previously stored status does not establish fresh work.
exclusions.configuration_preview: A dry-run preview is not a completed export or configuration change.
exclusions.external_application: Opening Obsidian does not observe another application's use.
exclusions.instructions: Displaying static instructions does not establish use of the described workflow.
exclusions.derived_hook: Agent hooks and their derived ingestion have no inferred product telemetry owner.
